invariants.rationale: The result returned by the method is either a valid index or -1 if not over an item; thus result cannot be less than -1.
If result is negative, it must be -1; otherwise, when not -1, result represents a valid index which is less than items.size.
Return value is -1 if not over an item, otherwise it is a valid index in the list.
The y coordinate is used to determine the item index in the visual region, and is unlikely to validly exceed getHeight().
A valid list must have a positive itemHeight, otherwise division by zero or negative values are likely to break logic.
